description:
What one portfolio returned over its record: growth per year before and after inflation,
        best and worst months and years, every 12-month stretch, returns by month and year,
        and weight drift between rebalances. Typical questions: 'How did this portfolio do
        over the years?'; 'What was its worst year?'; 'Returns after inflation, please.'.
        Instead: for crises only, past_crises. For money put in every month, monthly_plan.
        Past record, not a forecast. It does not recommend, predict or calculate tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: number}, 1 to 100 holdings. Weights in any scale (60/20/20 or 0.6/0.2/0.2) or money amounts in the base currency (60000/20000/20000): holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, which makes the falls come out in money. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, EQQQ.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash). Example: {"VTI": 60, "VXUS": 20, "BND": 20}.
holdings.title: Holdings

name: return_history

outputSchema.description: The mix's record: yearly and monthly returns, rolling 12 months, drift.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

cagr.description: Growth per year over the record.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

distribution.description: Histogram of monthly returns: centers, counts.

drift.description: Per holding: target weight and how far it drifted between rebalances.

grid.description: Monthly returns: one row per year, null where the record has no month.

months.description: Month names, aligned with each row of `grid`.

rolling_stats.description: Any 12 months in a row: min, max, percentiles, share negative.

stats.description: best_month, worst_month, best_year, worst_year, pct_positive, n_months, var95, cvar95, real_cagr (after inflation).

yearly.description: Return per calendar year, aligned with `years`.

title: The record, month by month
